description: React component for displaying a single product page, including product details, image gallery, add to cart functionality, and login/register modal handling.

classes.name: SingleProduct
classes.description: React component class for rendering a single product page with cart and modal interactions.

methods.name: loginClicked
methods.description: Prepares and shows the login modal.

methods.name: registerClicked
methods.description: Prepares and shows the registration modal.

methods.name: handleThumbnailClick
methods.description: Handles thumbnail image click to update product image and details.

methods.name: onAddClicked
methods.description: Increases product quantity and updates cart.

methods.name: onRemoveClicked
methods.description: Decreases product quantity and updates cart.

methods.name: addToBag
methods.description: Adds product to cart if user is authenticated, otherwise shows login modal.

methods.name: productInCart
methods.description: Checks if product is already in cart (currently commented out logic).

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the product page UI including images, details, and modal.
